Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase. Regis Chakabva and Takudzwanashe Kaitano are the openers for Zimbabwe. Dushmantha Chameera to start with the new ball.
... The Chase ...

Sri Lanka did well to cross the 250 mark. They started well but lost their momentum as the game progressed. At one stage it was looking that 300 was possible but that was not the case. The openers did well to give a good start. Nissanka scored yet another half-century but things got slow against the spinners. Each batter was getting a start but at a slow pace and then Asalanka decided to counter-attack. He scored a half-century and then perished. The lower-ender with Chamika Karunaratne and Ramesh Mendis did really well to chip in with some crucial runs.  Now then, the pitch is clearly favoring the spinners and slow balls. Sri Lanka do have some spin attack and Zimbabwe batters are in top form. It will be very exciting to see how things unfold. Stay tuned as the second essay is coming up.

It was a collective bowling performance from Zimbabwe. they started poorly with pacers leaking runs but once the spinners came in, wickets started falling and it was hard to score as well. There is turn and the batters are facing it hard to counterattack the spinners. Zimbabwe did well to take wickets at regular intervals and kept the pressure throughout the innings. Spinners created pressure in the middle phase and then pacers came in with variation and did not allow the opposition to score freely. Everyone except Raza took a wicket each and were economical as well. But let us not forget how good the players were in the field. They really backed their bowlers well and will certainly be a lot happy about the same.

Well, 254 is not a huge total but if you look at the pitch, it is not an easy one to bat on. Sri Lankan batters have done their job and if their bowlers cash in, the hosts will fancy sealing the series. Zimbabwe on the other end, have the momentum and will look to continue the same. They did really well to clean the tail-enders quickly.
BYE! Length ball, outside off. Maheesh Theekshana swings hard but misses. The batters though were quick to collect a bye. SRI LANKA END THEIR INNINGS AT 254/9.
Short and outside off. Jeffrey Vandersay cuts it to point for a single.
Full length, on off. Jeffrey Vandersay slashes it through covers for a couple of runs.
Full and on off. Maheesh Theekshana lofts it over covers for a single.
Maheesh Theekshana walks out.

OUT! RUN OUT! A length ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne slaps it down the ground to long on and gets across for a couple of runs. Ryan Burl throws the ball towards the keeper, after seeing the batters push hard for two runs. The throw is accurate and Regis Chakabva is quick to get the bails off. Chamika Karunaratne puts in a dive but ends up being short as confirmed by the TV umpire.
Is that a run out? It is very close. OUT shows the big screen.
BYE! Full and wide outside off. Jeffrey Vandersay looks to chase it but misses. Chamika Karunaratne gets to the other end and they take a bye.
Length ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne punches it back to the bowler. Chamika Karunaratne will not be on strike for the final over.
Jeffrey Vandersay comes in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Richard Ngarava gets his second wicket of the game. A full toss, on off. Dushmantha Chameera swings his blade at it. The ball goes off the splice towards mid off. Sean Williams slides in to his left and gathers the ball safely.
Commentary.Howout: c Sean Williams b Richard Ngarava

Commentary.Commentary: Full and wide outside off. Chameera shuffles across and looks to heave it away but misses.
A single as this is hit down the ground to long on.
Full length, wide outside off, just inside the tramline. Chamika Karunaratne leaves it alone.
Low full toss and outside off. Chamika Karunaratne slashes it through covers for a brace.
Full and on off, pushed towards cover for a single.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Chamika Karunaratne looks to chase it but misses. Wide called.
Full and wide outside off. Dushmantha Chameera drags it from outside off to long on for a single.
Dushmantha Chameera walks out.

OUT! DRAGGED ON! Blessing Muzarabani strikes in his ninth over. He is elated with this wicket. A full-length ball, outside off. Ramesh Mendis comes across and looks to go for the lap shot but only manages to get a bail off the leg stump. The umpire wants to take it upstairs. It was a clear cut out.
FOUR! Nicely played. Back of a length, on middle. Mendis stays back and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary. He finds the gap brilliantly this time.
A yorker, on off. Chamika Karunaratne digs it into the deck and gets across to the other side for a single.

A short ball, on off, a slower one this time. Chamika Karunaratne waits and slams it down the ground towards long on. Ryan Burl covers a lot of ground to his left, dives over the ball but does well to stop it in the end. They take two.
WIDE! Full and sliding down leg. Chamika Karunaratne looks to flick it away but misses. Wide called.
Full and outside off. Chamika Karunaratne drives it towards extra cover for a single.
Another single now, as this is worked towards cover.
Low full toss, outside off. Chamika Karunaratne reaches out and hits it uppishly off the toe-end towards cover for a single.
Halt in play. The physio is out as Ramesh Mendis need some treatment here.

Full length, wide outside off. Mendis comes across a long way and looks to scoop it away. He gets an inside edge to get hit above his knees. The batters take a single but Mendis looks to be in some pain here.
FOUR! Brilliant from Ramesh Mendis. Back of a length, on off. Mendis hangs back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. He gets it through the gap, no chance for any fielder to chase it down.
Full length, outside off. Chamika Karunaratne crunches it to mid off. The fielder moves to his left to stop it. They take one.
Richard Ngarava is back into the attack.
Fuller, on off. Chamika Karunaratne hits it down the ground but only to meet the stumps at the other end. They only get one.
Length and on top of off. Mendis punches it to cover and scampers through for a quick single. This pair has ran excellently between the wickets.
Blessing Muzarabani fires in a yorker on middle. Chamika Karunaratne jams it towards mid on for another run.
Good length, on off. Mendis gets an inside edge onto the pads. They take a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Chamika Karunaratne shuffles across and pulls it to deep mid-wicket yet again. But only for a single this time.

FOUR! Nicely played. A much-needed boundary for Sri Lanka after 41 deliveries. Short ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne pulls it to deep mid-wicket and beats the diving effort of the man in the deep for a boundary.
Good running! It's been a while since the hosts have scored a boundary. Full, on leg. Mendis clips it through square leg for a couple of runs now.
Short and on off. Chamika Karunaratne pulls it through mid on for another single.
A length ball, on off. Mendis comes down the track and hits it to long on for a single.
Slower, full and on off. Chamika Karunaratne hits it down the ground with a single hand for a single.
Dead ball called. Tendai Chatara just lost his grip here as he was about to release it and the ball lobs in the air.
BEATEN! An off-pace, full-length delivery, outside off. Chamika Karunaratne looks to chase it but get beaten on the outside edge.
Fuller, on leg, at 120 clicks, flicked to deep square leg for a run.
Length and on the pads. Mendis nudges it through mid-wicket for a single. A great over by Blessing Muzarabani, only 2 runs off it.
Full length, on off. Mendis comes forward and defends it to cover. Zimbabwe have done well throughout the innings to put on some pressure with the dot balls.
Good length, outside off. Some extra bounce off the deck. Mendis stays on the back foot and looks to cut it away but misses.
Back of a length, on off, pulled to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Good length, outside off. Chamika Karunaratne pushes it to cover.
Short and on off. Chamika Karunaratne stays back and looks to pull it away but only gets an inside edge to get hit on his thigh pad.
Blessing Muzarabani is back on.
Good running yet again! Fuller, wide outside off. Mendis slashes it through point for two runs.
Full length, on off. Chamika Karunaratne hits it down the ground for yet another single.
Short ball, on the body. Mendis pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Fuller, on off. Chamika Karunaratne pushes it to mid off for another single.

Good running! A full-length ball, on off. Mendis gets an inisde edge on it. The ball sneaks between his legs, could've easily dragged it on. Chamika Karunaratne was quick to call for a single and Mendis responded really well.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Chamika Karunaratne flicks it past mid on and gets across for an easy single.

Full and outside off. Chamika Karunaratne hits it to long off for a run. With this single 200 is up for Sri Lanka. A brilliant spell by Wellington Masakadza, just 42 runs and a wicket in his 10 overs.
Pushed to mid off for a single.
Looped up, on middle and leg. Mendis tucks it to mid on for a brace.
Full and on off. Chamika Karunaratne defends it to cover for a quick single.
Tossed up, full and outside off. Chamika Karunaratne presses forward to defend it out.
Floated, full, on the pads. Mendis flicks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Full and on leg. Mendis clips it to the leg side for a single.
On off, blocked out.
Ramesh Mendis walks out to the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Tendai Chatara gets a big wicket of Charith Asalanka which also will be his 100th wicket in ODI cricket. He is the quickest Zimbabwe player to achieve this feat. A full-length ball, outside off. Charith Asalanka leans in and chips it towards backward point. Wellington Masakadza takes the simplest of catches. Sri Lanka in a spot of trouble here.
Commentary.Howout: c Wellington Masakadza b Tendai Chatara

Commentary.Commentary: Is that out? Soft signal is out! Looks like it came off the blade.....and the big screen shows OUT!
Length, angled in on middle and leg. Asalanka comes forward and flicks it to the leg side.
Length ball, on off. Chamika Karunaratne pushes it to cover for a quick single.
Good length, outside off. Asalanka guides it to third man for a single.
WIDE! Back of a length, angling down leg. Asalanka looks to pull it away but misses. Wide called by the umpire.
End of Powerplay 2! Now, 5 fielders can be stationed outside the 30-yard circle. Also, Tendai Chatara is back into the attack for Zimbabwe.
This one spins back in, Asalanka plays it late and towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short and on off, drilled down to long on for a single.

Fifty for Charith Asalanka! On middle, tucked away to mid-wicket for a single. Asalanka has done really well to score runs at a brisk pace and now will look to score more quickly in the last 10 overs.
Flatter and on off, Chamika Karunaratne punches it through covers for a single.
Tossed up. Defended out.
On middle, drilled down to long on as Asalanka pushes it through the diving bowler. One.
Outside off, on a length. Asalanka plays it to third man and keeps the strike.
On the pads, this is flicked to square leg for a single.
Chamika Karunaratne is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Sikandar Raza holds onto it. What a catch! Good reflex shown by him this time! This is short and outside off. Shanaka cuts it uppishly and towards backward point where Raza is stationed. The ball comes quickly to him but he does well to take it near his chest. Timely wicket for Zimbabwe and no heroics from Shanaka in this innings.
Commentary.Howout: c Sikandar Raza b Richard Ngarava

Commentary.Commentary: Short of a length, angling around off. Shanaka looks to pull but misses. Was early into his shot.
Now tries to guide it past but can't beat the fielder at backward point.
FOUR! Welcome boundary for Sri Lanka and will release a bit of pressure as well. This was on a length, on middle. Shanaka hammers it straight past the bowler for a boundary.
Short and outside off, Shanaka cuts it through covers for a single to end the over.
Quicker one, on off. Shanaka defends it to point.
On middle, flicked to square leg for a single.
Around off, pushed to covers for a single.
Again sharp spin but this time Asalanka pushes it to long on for a single.
This one spins back in sharply. Short and on middle, pushed to point.
A full ball, slower on off, Shanaka knocks it to cover. Just two runs off it.

Good stop by Sikandar Raza! A length ball, outside off. Shanaka slaps it late and towards point where Raza akes a stop to his left. Zimbabwe have been brilliant on the pitch today, fielding in precise.
Length and on middle, Asalanka nudges it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
BEATEN! Lovely delivery! Just make it to shape away! On a length, just outside off. Charith Asalanka looks to defend but misses.
On a length, on off, tucked away on the leg side for a single.
Full and outside off, pushed to covers.
Tossed up, on middle, Asalanka keeps it out. Just three of it.
Flatter and on off. Shanaka taps it to point for a quick single.
Again plays with the spin and this time pushes it to long on for a single.
On middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Short and spinning back in, Asalanka plays it with spin to mid-wicket.
Full and on off, pushed to long off for a single.
Length ball, slanting on off. Asalanka defends it on the front foot.
Length and on middle, pulled away to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Slightly short, on off. Shanaka drops it to cover.
Length and outside off. Shanaka dabs it away but the fielder at short third man does well to cut it off.
Short of a length, on off. Asalanka hops and punches it to deep cover and rotates the strike.
Full and way outside off. Shanaka reaches and drives it through covers for a single.

DRINKS! Zimbabwe have made a solid comeback in the game by taking quick wickets. Sri Lanka, on the other hand, would hope this pair can take the innings deep. A huge partnership by the pair can swing the advantage back in their favour. An intriguing passage of play awaits.

FOUR! Good shot! Charith Asalanka keeping the scoreboard ticking and playing his natural shots. Good shot though. This is full and on the pads. Asalanka gets on his knee and sweeps it through square leg for a boundary.
Tossed up, on middle. Charith Asalanka prods and defends it out.
Full and on leg, flicked to mid-wicket  for a single.
Flatter and outside off. Asalanka chips it in the air and through covers for a single.
FOUR! A half-tracker, on middle. Asalanka rocks back and pulls it in the gap towards mid-wicket for a boundary.
Tossed up, on middle. Blocked out.
On the stumps. pushed to long on for a single.
Touch fuller and this is pushed down to long off for one more.
On middle. Defended out.
Flatter and on off, Asalanka taps it to point for a single.
A full ball, outside off, pushed through the diving bowler to long off for a single.
Full and on middle, this is hit to mid-wicket.
On middle. Asalanka keeps it out.

In the air but safe! Short and on middle. Asalanka rocks back and pulls it, not quite off the middle, in the air and towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Lucky for him that the ball went wide of the fielder there.
Tossed up, on middle, Shanaka wrists it to square leg to get off the mark with a single.
A short ball, drifting on middle, pulled away to long on for a single.
This one comes with the angle, around off. Asalanka plays it late and towards short third man.
Short and on middle. Asalanka punches off the back foot to covers.
Dasun Shanaka is the new man in. Can the skipper repeat his feat from the last game?

OUT! LBW! A tossed up ball, slanting around off. Chandimal steps down and across and tries to sweep it but misses. An appeal for LBW but not given. That looked plumb and there was no second thought to take the review. Zimbabwe looked confident and took the review. UltraEdge shows no bat there. Ball Tracker shows three reds and Chandimal has to walk back. Brilliant from Williams, in his very first over and the spinners continue to do the job for Zimbabwe.

Review! Craig Ervine decides to take the review for LBW! The on-field decision is not out. The UltraEdge shows no bat is involved. The Ball Tracker shows three reds and Dinesh Chandimal has to walk back. The umpire has to overturn his original decision. A brilliant review by Zimbabwe.
Short and outside off, punched to point by Chandimal.
A loopy ball, on off, drilled down to long on for one more.
This one spins away from the left-hander, around off, this is hit through covers for a single.
This is full, quicker and on middle. Chandimal comes down the track and tries to heave it but misses and gets hit on the pads.
Full and outside off, pushed to covers.
Sean Williams is into the attack now.
Full length, outside off. Chandimal steps across and defends it to cover for a quick single.
Tap and run! Length and outside off. Asalanka pushes it to cover for a quick single.
Full length, outside off. Asalanka taps it to point. The fielder there dives to his right to make a good stop.
Back of a length, outside off. Chandimal cuts it to deep point for a single.
Good length, on the pads. Asalanka flicks it to mid-wicket for a single. This is good batting, following a boundary with a single.
FOUR! Timed to perfection. A full-length ball, outside off. Asalanka punches it through covers, off the bottom half of the blade to bag a boundary.
A dot to end the over! Tossed up, on leg. Chandimal nudges it to mid-wicket.
Fuller, on off. Asalanka pushes it through covers for a run.
Full and on leg. Chandimal flicks it in a pocket at mid-wicket and gets across for a single.
Full and on leg, Chandimal gets his back foot in the air and clips it straight to the man at mid-wicket.
Full and on off. Asalanka pushes it to mid off for a run.
On off, pushed to point.
Length and outside off. Asalanka works it through backward point for a single.

FOUR! EDGY! A full-length ball, outside off. Asalanka looks to defend it out, it takes the outside edge and flies past the keeper for a boundary. Only if slip fielder was in place Zimbabwe could've gotten a crucial wicket here.
A length ball, around off, shaping away from the left-hander. Asalanka looks to play it to the leg side with a cross-batted stroke but misses, it goes off his pads to the left of the keeper.
Length ball, on the fourth stump line. Chandimal hangs back and opens his face of the bat late to steer it down to third man for a run.
Good length, outside off. Asalanka punches it through point for a single.
Full length, outside off. Charith Asalanka drives it to cover.
Blessing Muzarabani is back into the attack now.
FOUR! This boundary spoils a good over for Sikandar Raza. Tossed up, full and outside off. Chandimal leans in and drives it through covers for a boundary.
On middle, blocked out watchfully.
Almost caught and bowled here! Fuller, on off. Chandimal chips it back to the bowler. The ball stays low to the deck and bounces just in front of the bowler.
Full and outside off. Chandimal pushes it to cover.
Fuller, on middle, Asalanka works it to wide of long on for another single.
Floated, full and on leg. Chandimal eases it to long on for a single.
Short and outside off. Chandimal cuts it to cover for a single.
A single as this is eased down to long on.
Short and on top of off. Asalanka makes room and looks to cut it away but gets it back to the bowler off the inner half.
Full and on off. Chandimal pushes it to cover for a single.
Short and outside off. Dinesh Chandimal cuts it to cover.
Full and on leg, Asalanka flicks it to square leg for a run.
Around off, pushed to long off for a single.
Good fielding! This is full and on off. Charith Asalanka hits it hard and towards cover where the fielder does well to stop it.
Slower, short and outside off. Asalanaka slaps it to deep cover for a brace.
Angles it on middle, pushed back to the bowler.
On middle. Blocked out.
A loopy ball, on middle, tucked away to square leg for a single.
A dot ball to end the over! This is hit to square leg. 8 runs and a wicket off this over.
Good running! Tossed up, on middle. Asalanaka flicks it to mid-wicket and takes a couple of runs.
Very full, on off, pushed to deep cover for a single.
Full ball, outside off. Asalanka hits it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! Deft touch! Short and outside off. Asalanaka opens the bat face and dabs it to the third man fence.
Charith Asalanka is the new man in.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! A full ball, on middle, Mendis comes down the track and hits it with a full face of the bat, straight back to the bowler. Burl appeals and was confident as well. An appeal for caught and bowled is taken upstairs, the catch was clean but the only question was if it was a bump ball. Replay rolls in and the ball clearly came off the blade. Zimbabwe on the front foot suddenly with two quick wickets.

Is that out? The soft signal is NOT OUT. The umpire takes it upstairs. The replays show the ball does not hit the deck off the bat and comes off the face of the blade. The final decision is OUT on the big screen.
Good running! Tossed up, outside off. Chandimal drives it to long off and takes a quick couple.
Full and outside off, pushed nicely but finds the cover fielder.
Leg bye! Flatter and on off. Mendis steps across and tries to reverse sweep but misses and gets hit on the pads. A leg bye as it rolls to square leg.
Full and on middle, drilled down to long on for a single. A late no ball called as Raza overstepped. Free-Hit coming up.
Short and angling on middle, punched off the back foot to covers for a single.
Dinesh Chandimal comes in at number 4.

OUT! RUN OUT! Nissanka's brilliant knock comes to an end with some mix-up. He will feel, he missed out to convert this into a big score. Was really a good chance! Tossed up, outside off. Mendis works it to point. There was never a run but Nissanka is down the track for a single but was sent back by Mendis. A direct hit from the substitute fielder, Wesley Madhevere at the bowler's end. Zimbabwe were confident and the replay showed that Nissanka was well short of his crease.
Is that a run out? The umpire takes it upstairs. The replays show Nissanka was well short of the crease and the final decision is OUT. A huge blow for Sri Lanka.
Short and on middle. Nissanka pulls it to square leg for a single.
Sikandar Raza comes into the attack now.
Shorter and outside off, this is hit to deep point for a single to end the over. Also, 100 up for Sri Lanka!
On middle. Mendis bunts it wide of long on for a single.
This is full and on off. Nissanka works it to covers. A fumble and a single is taken.
Around off, pushed to covers.
Full and on off. Nissanka keeps it out.
On middle, drilled down to long on for a single.
Just 5 coming off it then, another good over from Burl! Flatter and on middle, tucked away to square leg.
Good fielding! On middle. Nissanka whacks it to the left of short fine leg and the fielder there dives and saves a certain boundary.

FOUR! Fifty for Pathum Nissanka! His second in this series. Some serious talent! This is full and outside off. Nissanka opens his bat face and guides it through backward point for a  boundary. Welcome boundary as well.
Keeps it slow and gives flight to it as well, outside off, pushed to point.
Fuller and on middle. Mendis works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Mendis comes down and hits this full ball to mid off.
A single again, as this eased down to long on.
Touch short, outsiden off. Nissanka stays back and punches it to point for a single.
Full and on off. Mendis pushes it to long off for a single.
Three dots in a row! On leg, Mendis works it to the leg side yet again.
Floats it up, on middle and leg. Mendis tucks it to mid-wicket.
On leg, defended to the leg side.
Five singles in a row to end the over! The batters are making sure to keep the runs ticking. Full and on leg. Nissanka clips it to mid-wicket. One.
Full and outside off. Nissanka helps it to extra cover for a run.
Around off, worked to point for another single.
Nissanka misses out this time. Low full toss, on off. Nissanka hits it to the left of long off for a single.

Quick single! This is another suicidal single, Sri Lanka have done this several times in this innings. Full and on off. Mendis leans in and pushes it to mid off and scampers through for a quick single.
Tossed up, full and on leg. Mendis clips it to square leg.
A single as this is worked to long on for a run.
Short and outside off. Mendis hangs back and cuts it towards point for a run.
On leg, flicked to square leg for a single.
On off, defended out.

DRINKS! Spinners doing a great job for Zimbabwe. They have built pressure and as a result, also broke the opening stand as well. They will look for few more wickets and pile up the pressure. Kamindu Mendis will join Pathum Nissanka in the middle.

OUT! CAUGHT! Kusal Mendis tries to break the shackles but holes out instead. He actually gifted his wicket here. Floated, full and on off. Mendis makes room and chips it inside out towards long off. Blessing Muzarabani comes forward and takes the simplest of catches. Wellington Masakadza draws the first blood. The spinners have done well to put a lid over the run rate and kept building the pressure. Eventually, the pressure got to Mendis and he walks back to the pavilion after a soft dismissal.
Commentary.Howout: c Blessing Muzarabani b Wellington Masakadza

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker, flatter and outside off. Mendis cuts it to point.
Full and outside off. Mendis steers it down to short third man for a single.
Around middle, blocked to the leg side.
Tossed up, on off. Mendis pushes it to mid off.
On off, pushed out.

NOT OUT! Full and on off. Mendis gets low and sweeps it to mid-wicket. The fielder gets low to right to make the stop. Mendis was down the track for a single but Nissanka sends him back. The throw is not a sharp one to the keeper. Mendis scampers back and makes it in just in time. The TV umpire is consulted and the replays confirm Mendis is safe.
Is that a run out? The replay shows the batter is all right as he puts in a big dive.
Around middle and leg. Nissanka pushes it to mid on for a run.
Quicker, full and on off. Mendis pushes it to cover, not in the gap though.
On off, Nissanka pushes it to cover for a run.
Around off, Mendis eases it towards the off side for another single.
Full and on off. Nissanka pushes it to long off for a single.
Looped up, full and outside off. Nissanka chips it towards mid on.
In the air...safe! Fuller, on middle. Mendis gets low and looks to go for the slog-sweep. He gets an outside edge, it flies high in the air towards mid-wicket but lands safely. They take one.
Flatter and this is driven to long off for a single. Spinners keeping it tight while the pacers are leaking runs.
Slightly short, outside off. Mendis cuts hard but finds short third man.
Good stop! Full and on middle, pushed to the right of the bowler, Burl dives to stop.
Tossed up, on off, this is hit to long off for a single.
Gives more flight to it, on middle. Nissanka works it on the leg side.
Fuller, flighted, outside off. Nissanka slaps it to point. A fumble there but no runs taken.
Ryan Burl to bowl now.
Single to end the over then! Tossed up, outside off. Nissanka leans and punches it to long off for one more.
A single as this is driven to long off.
Around off, pushed straight to point.
Short and outside off, it stays a bit low, cut away to point.
Full ball, outside off, eased down to long off for a single.
Full and on off, pushed to covers.

FOUR! Edgy! A length ball, juts around off. Mendis looks to cut but gets an outside edge and beats the diving keeper as well as the ball races away to the third man fence. Frustration for Richard Ngarava.
FOUR! Runs coming nicely for Sri Lanka now! On a length, on middle. Mendis hammers it to mid-wicket. The fielder gives a chase and dives, flicks it back to save a couple.
Short ball, on middle. Nissanka gets on top of it and pulls it to square on the leg side. One.
Full now, on middle, Mendis turns it to deep square leg for a single.
On middle, pulled away to deep square leg for one.
Direct hit and Mendis was a goner! He sold himself short there! Length and on off. Mendis taps it to point and runs across for a quick single. The fielder has a shy at the bowler's end but misses.
FOUR! Played very fine and beats the running fielder as well. Good hit! Darted on the pads. Pathum Nissanka tickles it fine to the fine leg fence.
Slightly short, on off. Mendis punches it through covers for one more.
An arm ball, on off, drilled down to long off for a single.
A single as this is driven to sweeper cover.
Tossed up, on middle, Mendis works it to mid on.
Full ball, on middle, this is pushed to the right of the bowler.
Time for some spin. Wellington Masakadza comes into the attack now.
Full ball at 134 clicks, this is hit to covers.
Length ball, outside off. Mendis guides it to third man for one.
Full and on off, pushed to mid off.
FOUR! 50 up for Sri Lanka and these two are changing the gears now! This is short and on middle, not too short but Mendis does well to get low and pull it to square leg for another boundary.
On middle. Blocked out.

FOUR! That went like a bullet! Richard Ngarava stares down at the batter. If the fielder was placed a bit to his left, this was staright under his throat. This is full and slanting on off. Mendis heaves it to mid-wicket for a boundary.
Time for Powerplay 2! This means now 4 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle until the end of the 40th over.
On off, Nissanka remains solid in his defence.
Full length, on off. Nissanka pushes it towards mid off with soft hands.
Fuller, outside off. Nissanka pushes it out to safety.
Full-length ball, outside off. Nissanka guides it past backward point and gets a couple of runs.
Full length, on the pads, Nissanka nudges it to the leg side.
Fuller, on leg. Nissanka clips it through the gap at mid-wicket. The batters take two before the fielder cuts it out.
Five dots on the trot to end the over! Full length, outside off. Mendis leans and drives it to covers. Not in the gap though.
Length ball, on top of off. Mendis blocks it out to safety. This has been a good comeback by Ngarava after being hit for a boundary off the first.
Full length, outside off. Mendis punches it to point.
Angled across, full and on off. Mendis defends it to the off side.
Fuller, on off, blocked out.
FOUR! Top shot! Short ball, on off. Mendis hangs back and pulls to deep square leg for a boundary.

FOUR! Streaky! Nissanka has some lady luck alongside him. The keeper moved a little early towards the ball and misjudged it completely. Back of a length, on off. Nissanka looks to hook it away, it takes the outside edge and Regis Chakabva moves to his right behind the stumps and is a tad late in getting his gloves above his head. Boundary at fine leg.
Full, on leg. Nissanka defends it to the leg side.
FOUR! Looks like Nissanka has got his eye in. Overpitched, on off. Nissanka stands tall and drives it gloriously down the ground to get a boundary at long off.
Another single now! This is good running. Good length, angled into the pads, Mendis clips it towards mid on and takes off for a run.
Good length, outside off. Nissanka steers it down to third man for a single.
Back of a length, on off. Nissanka defends it out watchfully.
A maiden to start with for Ngarava. Full, on off. Mendis defends it to point. Zimbabwe have been solid in the field so far, really good backing for the bowlers.
What a stop! Brilliant by Shumba. Touch short and on off. Mendis heaves it across the line to mid-wicket. Shumba dives to his left to stop a certain boundary.
Ngarava fires in a full-length delivery, on the stumps. Mendis digs it out back to the bowler.
Length ball, on middle and leg. Mendis stays back and nudges it to mid-wicket.
Full, on leg. Mendis tucks it to the leg side.
Full length, outside off, shaping away from the right-hander. Mendis punches it to point.
Richard Ngarava is into the attack now.
Just three runs off it! Length, on the pads. Mendis nudges it to mid-wicket for a quick single.

Two dots in a row! This is brilliant bowling by Blessing Muzarabani. Not giving much room to play with. Back of a length, outside off, shaping in a long way but a little late. Mendis hangs back and shoulders his arms at it. The keeper does well to dive to his left and gather the ball.
Full length, on middle, angling in. Mendis hangs back and defends it onto the deck.
Good length, on the pads. Nissanka clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller, outside off. Nissanka comes forward and pushes it to cover.

EDGED! A length ball, outside off, shaping away a hint. Mendis looks to defend it out but gets an outside edge. The ball lands short of the man at first slip, but Sikandar Raza does well to let it run away from a boundary by getting a hand on it. They take a single.
FOUR! Timing! This is full and on middle. Pathum Nissanka leans and flicks it through mid-wicket and bags a boundary. Boundary to start and end the over.
Around off, fuller, pushed to covers.
Length and on middle, tucked away to square leg.
Full and on off. Pathum pushes it nicely but straight to covers.
On middle, on a length, Kept out.
FOUR! Through the legs of the fielder and the hosts score their first boundary! Length ball, outside off. Nissanka slaps it to covers where the fielder lets it through for a boundary.
Single to end the over! Short of a length, outside off. Nissanka steers it to third man for a single.
Overpitched, outside off. Nissanka punches it to covers.
On middle, flicked wide of mid-wicket for a brace.

Good work from Sean Williams! This is full and outside off. Mendis crisps it to the right of mid off. Williams there dives to that side and saves a certain boundary. His team-mates were quick to appreciate his effort.
On the pads, Nissanka nudges it through square leg for a single. Quiet start from Sri Lanka so far.
Full and on off. Blocked out.
A direct hit and Nissanka would have been in trouble! Full and on off, Nissanka pushes it to mid off and runs across for a quick single. Puts a big dive to make his ground.
Pitches it up, on middle, too straight as well, Mendis wrists it through mid-wicket. The fielder gives a chase and cuts it out near the ropes. Three.
Length ball, this one nips back in, on middle, tucked away to deep square leg for a single.
Coming nicely onto the bat! Full ball, outside off. Nissanka plants his front foot out and drives it to covers.
Full ball, shaping slightly away, outside off, pushed to covers.
Length and on off. Nissanka blocks it out.
Kusal Mendis is off the mark as well! This is full and on off, driven through covers as the fielder there lets it through his hands for a couple of runs.
Blessing Muzarabani mixing his lines! Now serves it full and on off. Defended out.
Short ball, but this is way outside off. Left alone.
Full and on middle. Blocked out.
Length ball, slanting around off. Nissanka dabs it with soft hands to third man for a single.
Length ball, outside off, Nissanka shoulders arms to it.
Blessing Muzarabani has been handed the second new ball and will steam in from the other end.
Sri Lanka and Tendai Chatara are underway! This is full but angling on the pads. Nissanka flicks it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Tendai Chatara keeping it tight and serving it on a fuller length, on off, pushed to point.
Full ball, this one comes with the angle, on middle. Pathum Nissanka prods and keeps it out.
On middle, on a fuller length. Nissanka defends it out.
Full again, way outside off. Nissanka guides it to point.
Some shape straightaway! A full ball, shaping a bit away, outside off. Nissanka blocks it on the deck.

The game is set to begin. The Zimbabwe players stride out to the middle. Followed by Pathum Nissanka and Kusal Mendis who walk out to bat for Sri Lanka. Tendai Chatara to start with the new ball. Here we go...

PITCH REPORT - Farveez Maharoof is near the deck. He says, the weather is hot and humid. Adds that the surface is the same as the previous two games, it is very hard. Tells that the spinners will enjoy more in the second half of the game and the captain winning the toss and will like to bat first.
Craig Ervine, the skipper of Zimbabwe, is for a chat. He says, the wicket has been similar throughout the series. Mentions he backs his players to chase down the target is such conditions.

Dasun Shanaka, the skipper of Sri Lanka, after winning the toss for the first time, says that they will bat first. Adds that it is a good batting track and and it will slow down as the game progresses and is happy to set a target this time.

Zimbabwe (Playing XI) - Takudzwanashe Kaitano, Regis Chakabva (WK), Craig Ervine (C), Sean Williams, Milton Shumba (In for Wesley Madhevere), Sikandar Raza, Ryan Burl, Wellington Masakadza, Blessing Muzarabani, Tendai Chatara, Richard Ngarava.

Sri Lanka (Playing XI) - Pathum Nissanka, Kusal Mendis (WK), Kamindu Mendis, Dinesh Chandimal, Charith Asalanka, Dasun Shanaka, Chamika Karunaratne, Maheesh Theekshana, Jeffrey Vandersay, Dushmantha Chameera, Ramesh Mendis (In for Nuwan Pradeep).
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of Sri Lanka. They have opted to BAT first.

Sri Lanka fought hard but failed to cross the line. Shanaka scored his maiden ODI century but it came in a lost cause. He hardly got any support from the other end and hence they could not seal the series, like they would've liked too. With 10 World Cup Super League points up for grabs, an exciting contest awaits. Stay tuned for the toss and other updates.

Zimbabwe showed good fight in the second ODI after their bowlers failed to defend an above par total in the first match. But discipline bowling helped them draw the series. With their batters performing really well, they will look to make history yet again after winning a series in 2017 against Sri Lanka.

Hello and a warm welcome to the third and final ODI between Sri Lanka and Zimbabwe. The series is nicely poised at 1-1 and it is time for the decider as both the teams look to grab the crucial points and jump up the World Cup Super League ladder. With high scoring games in the previous two matches, expect something similar here as well.
... MATCH DAY ...
